letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laughter is the soundtrack of my days, and your smile, my favorite sunrise. I adore how you turn ordinary moments into magical memories, and I’m forever grateful for the love that keeps us anchored across miles. Thank you for being my endless source of joy, my cutie, my forever home. I love you more with each passing day.
poem:
Across two cities, hearts entwine,  
Your love’s the rhythm, sweet as wine.  
In every night and sunlit glow,  
Together, forever, we’ll always grow.
